scope: All 63 in-scope skills across 14 buckets — the founding round.

excluded.why: the author's own CLAUDE.md defines these as promotion tiers — in-progress is beta, misc is 'kept around but rarely used'

method: Model council. Members Opus 5 and gpt-5.6-sol (high effort) each analysed all 63 skills independently and blind, reading full SKILL.md files and assets. Judge fable-xhigh consolidated, adjudicating 11 conflicts and verifying disputed claims against source. User then restored idea-refine.
carried_debts: agent-skills references/*.md: 7 shared files referenced by 11 skills, 9 of them in the adopted roster. doubt-driven-development's constraints are written against orchestration-patterns.md. Porting them is a mandatory adoption work item.
~9 adopted skills are merges; each needs its trigger eval rebuilt, since the upstream evals cover the originals.

reasoning: Same job as spec-driven-development, which is richer and has the stronger gate. Its one distinctive contribution — the hard no-implementation-until-approved gate — is absorbed. Its server-script bundle is a dependency both council members rejected.
A 7-line invocation wrapper with no method of its own. Both council members overturned the pre-computed 'genus' hint and called it an alias.
A 7-line composition wrapper — grilling plus documentation. Survives as a mode of grilling rather than a skill.

The only adversarial design-tree exhaustion: it walks the unblocked frontier of a FORMED plan breadth-first and forbids action until every branch is visited. Distinct from interview-me, which discovers latent intent for an UNFORMED want one question at a time. The judge overturned the council member that merged these: the two contradict each other on the primary mechanism (batch the frontier vs never batch), which is evidence of two tools, not one duplicated one. Decisive extra evidence found by the judge: grilling is a ticket type in wayfinder's taxonomy with human-in-the-loop semantics defined against it, so merging it away would force rewriting three kept skills plus a ticket taxonomy. Keeping it costs 22 lines.

modifications: absorb grill-me as a stateless invocation alias
absorb grill-with-docs as a documenting mode that calls domain-modeling when durable vocabulary or ADRs are needed

reasoning: RESTORED BY USER after the council. Both members and the judge agreed to drop it: the judge classed it product-shape ideation rather than engineering, and it was the only removal in the whole exercise with nothing salvaged into a survivor. The judge explicitly recorded it as recoverable intact, with no couplings into the rest of the corpus, and said to restore it if the adopting harness does product or design work as well as code. User exercised that option on 2026-08-11.

The only skill that targets the gap between what someone asks for and what they actually want. Carries an explicit-yes gate and a checkable stop test (predict the next three answers; if you can, stop asking).

The only skill producing an approved written spec behind a hard no-implementation gate, with a six-area content model. Chosen as the merge base over to-spec because it is richer and carries no issue-tracker dependency; ties break toward portability.

modifications: absorb brainstorming's hard design-approval gate, decomposition check and self-review
absorb to-spec's no-interview fast path for when discussion has already settled
deliberately_dropped: brainstorming's ~1,400-line visual-companion server bundle — heavy dependency, and prototype already covers the need

reasoning: The only skill whose artifact targets an absent third party who holds knowledge the user lacks. It interviews the user about the SEND (who, what is needed back), never about the subject.
Thinner than spec-driven-development and coupled to a specific issue tracker. Its no-interview fast path is the part worth keeping and was absorbed.
Same job as writing-plans with less operational detail and no execution handoff.
Same decomposition engine as writing-plans, different serialization. Kept as an output mode of the merged skill rather than a separate skill — one engine, two serializations.
The only inbound-work state machine, with concept-level redundancy checks and a prior-rejection knowledge base so the same proposal is not re-litigated.

The only planner for work larger than one context window under genuine uncertainty: fog-of-war decision tickets resolved one at a time until the route is clear. Has a documented local-markdown fallback when no tracker exists.
The only skill turning approved work into units executable with zero prior context. Chosen as merge base for its plan structure and required-sub-skill header.

modifications: absorb planning-and-task-breakdown's task sizing and ordering detail

absorb to-tickets as an OUTPUT MODE (plan file / tracker tickets with native blocking links / both) — the judge overruled the member who dropped this, because that member had itself called the loss 'the highest-value loss in this ledger'
absorb to-tickets' wide-refactor expand-then-contract rule

reasoning: The only skill covering contracts that outside code depends on, and the consequences of having consumers (Hyrum's Law, additive-only evolution). Both council members independently REJECTED the pre-computed hint pairing this with codebase-design: public contract design and internal module design have different consumers and different failure modes. This was the strongest joint no-duplication finding in the corpus.

modifications: trim the validation section to its design consequence; point the threat-model part at security-and-hardening rather than restating it

reasoning: The only source of deep-module vocabulary, with the anti-synonym rule, the deletion test and the two-adapters seam rule.

The only skill maintaining shared vocabulary as an active discipline. Becomes the single home for architecture decision records — the judge found two skills both claiming to own ADRs and resolved it here.

modifications: absorb ADR convention detection and the never-delete/supersede lifecycle
absorb one line from the gotchas section: comment the trap, link the ADR

reasoning: The only skill that FINDS restructuring candidates rather than applying a known one, scoped by commit-history hot spots. It consumes codebase-design's vocabulary rather than substituting for it.

modifications: demote the mandatory HTML report to optional — it pulls Tailwind and Mermaid from a CDN, a network dependency
move the load-bearing parts inline: recommendation-strength badges and the vocabulary discipline

reasoning: The only skill that answers a design question by building running throwaway code.
The only skill whose contract is change-how-it-reads-never-what-it-does, with an over-simplification guard.

Its own text says: 'If subagents are available, use subagent-driven-development instead of this skill.' Both council members cited that line independently. Survives as the degraded mode inside the winner.
The only UI skill. Its table of AI-aesthetic tells has no counterpart anywhere in the corpus.
A 15-line wrapper. Every clause it contains (use TDD, typecheck often, review after, commit) is owned by a kept skill.

The only implementation discipline that fires WITHOUT a plan — 'any change touching more than one file'. The judge rejected the member that merged this into plan execution: that merge's spine opens 'validate plan', which presupposes a plan and destroys the no-plan trigger. Different actor too: subagent-driven-development is a controller protocol, this is the discipline of the agent writing the code. Contract-first slicing and the NOTICED-BUT-NOT-TOUCHING rule are unique to it.
The corpus's single source of truth for treating input as untrusted. STRIDE, SSRF and TOCTOU coverage, OWASP LLM Top 10. Nothing else substitutes.
The only skill pinning framework facts to a version with citations and an UNVERIFIED flag. Distinct from research: this grounds decisions inline while building.

The only plan executor with bounded fix loops, capability escalation and an adjudication ledger that survives compaction. Superpowers' own writing-plans names it the recommended executor, and executing-plans defers to it explicitly.

modifications: absorb executing-plans as a degraded inline mode for when subagents are unavailable

reasoning: The only skill observing live runtime state in a real browser, with a blast-radius analysis for browser profiles. Requires the chrome-devtools MCP server.
Same discipline, thinnest of the three. Its pre-agreed-seams idea was absorbed.
Third copy of the same discipline; weaker enforcement than the superpowers version. Its distinctive content was absorbed.
The only discipline gate whose violation is recoverable only by deleting the code, with a mandatory watched-RED step. Chosen as merge base for enforcement strength.

modifications: absorb agent-skills' test-stack discovery, Prove-It rule and test-size model
absorb mattpocock's pre-agreed seams and mockability guidance
add a characterization-test allowance for legacy code — this matches the repo's own testing rule

reasoning: Same method. Absorbed except for its fallback guidance, which conflicted with the root-cause gate.

The only skill that makes building a reliable reproduction the skill itself, with a checkable phase-one exit: one command, already run at least once, that shows the bug red. The judge chose this spine over the alternative on enforcement strength.

modifications: absorb systematic-debugging's three-fixes escalation rule, per-boundary evidence requirement and its three technique assets
absorb debugging-and-error-recovery's non-reproducible decision tree and bisect method

Same job as code-review-and-quality. Its two genuinely distinctive rules were absorbed.

reasoning: The only in-flight per-decision adversarial review, with a pass-the-artifact-not-the-claim bias control. NOTE: depends on orchestration-patterns.md and on an agents/ persona roster — both must be ported.

The 'ask for a review' half of a two-part protocol; belongs with the rubric it dispatches. Note this merge requires repointing subagent-driven-development's hard reference to code-reviewer.md.
The only pre-claim gate, with a claim-to-required-evidence table. Fires before saying done, which is a different moment from reviewing code.

The only integration decision gate, with a typed-confirmation guard before destructive steps and a cleanup provenance rule. Both members rejected merging it with worktrees on trigger-ambiguity grounds.
The only skill covering commit discipline and the release contract together — semver as a promise, changelog written with the change.

reasoning: CONTINGENT REJECTION. Survives on its own inside bucket 13, but was killed on cross-bucket grounds: domain-modeling was also claiming to own ADRs, and two skills owning one artifact is exactly the duplication this exercise hunts. One council member kept both and never engaged the conflict. Content redistributed three ways — ADRs to domain-modeling, changelog to git-workflow-and-versioning, README/JSDoc/comment-why dropped as things the model already does. IF domain-modeling is ever not adopted, restore this as the single ADR home instead.
The only background-delegated primary-source investigation producing a durable cited artifact. Distinct from source-driven-development, which grounds decisions inline while building.

Not a software skill. It builds a multi-session personal learning workspace with missions, HTML lessons, learning records and spaced retrieval; its own examples are yoga and theoretical physics. Out of scope by KIND, not by redundancy — nothing duplicates it. Retained intact and self-contained if a personal-productivity catalog is ever wanted.

A 7-line conversational-repair macro: re-pitch the last message in Simplified Technical English. Output is consumed by a person, not the software system. Nearly free to reinstate later — user-invoked, zero always-on context cost.
